verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB is positioned as fully managed ClickHouse hosting, but it offers a BYOC deployment inside the customer's own AWS or Google Cloud account, and claims that in BYOC data never leaves "your cloud or your hardware." That gives partial self-hosting, with the product running in customer infrastructure. Missing for 10: a documented standalone self-hosted install (on-prem binaries, containers or open-source release) that users run and operate themselves, clear evidence that BYOC is customer-operated rather than vendor-managed, documentation of the "your hardware" option, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
